Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — great to hear more about Archway's content ingestion volume and the latency targets you mentioned for your clinician-facing workflows. Quick recap:

- Goal: reduce query latency for retrieval-augmented responses to <= 200ms p50 while keeping per-token costs under your target.
- Primary success criteria: sub-200ms median latency in production, reproducible evals on your sample prompts, and a predictable cost per 1M tokens.
- Technical constraints: HIPAA-adjacent dataflows, VPC requirement for production, and preference for mixed-precision quantized models.

We discussed running a hands-on 30-minute product walkthrough (high-level demo + ops questions) with your engineering and security leads present. To make scheduling easy, can you pick one of these windows (all times PT):

1) Tue Nov 3, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
2) Wed Nov 4, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
3) Thu Nov 5, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

Please let me know which slot works best and who from your team will attend (engineering, security, cloud/ops). I can send a calendar invite and a short mutual action plan (attached) so we can lock in owners and next milestones.

Attachments: MAP_Archway_AH-2026-074.xlsx (mutual action plan), SLA-summary.pdf

Next steps from our side if you pick a slot: I’ll include an agenda (5m intro, 15m product demo, 10m ops/security Q&A) and invite Karthik (technical lead) to handle the deep-dive portion.

If those three slots don't work, tell me two alternatives and we'll adjust.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
